# Expected values: GoogleSQL compliance functions_testlib_math_round.cc;
# BigQuery NUMERIC's range and CEIL/FLOOR definitions determine the overflow boundaries.
# SAFE. returns NULL for an evaluation error.

SELECT CEIL(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '2.3']) AS x
=> "3"

SELECT CEILING(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-2.3']) AS x
=> "-2"

SELECT FLOOR(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-2.3']) AS x
=> "-3"

SELECT CEIL(x) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)]) AS x
=> null

SELECT FLOOR(x) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)]) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE.CEIL(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE.CEILING(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.000000001']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FLOOR(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-99999999999999999999999999999.999999999']) AS x
=> null

SELECT CEIL(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999']) AS x
=> error:

SELECT FLOOR(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-99999999999999999999999999999.999999999']) AS x
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.CEIL(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999']) AS x
=> "99999999999999999999999999999"

SELECT SAFE.FLOOR(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-99999999999999999999999999999']) AS x
=> "-99999999999999999999999999999"

SELECT FLOOR(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999']) AS x
=> "99999999999999999999999999999"

SELECT CEIL(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-99999999999999999999999999999.999999999']) AS x
=> "-99999999999999999999999999999"

SELECT ROUND(x, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '1.25']) AS x
=> null

SELECT ROUND(x, CAST(NULL AS INT64), 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '1.25']) AS x
=> null

SELECT ROUND(x, CAST(NULL AS INT64), 'ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO') FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '1.25']) AS x
=> null

SELECT TRUNC(x, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '1.25']) AS x
=> null

# Column digits must work per row, not just as a literal. Values from the compliance data above.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(ROUND(NUMERIC '3.1415925', digits) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([2, 3, 10]) AS digits WITH OFFSET pos ORDER BY pos), ',')
=> "3.14,3.142,3.1415925"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(TRUNC(NUMERIC '314159.25', digits) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([-3, -2]) AS digits WITH OFFSET pos ORDER BY pos), ',')
=> "314000,314100"

# Rounding-mode examples from third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/mathematical_functions.md.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(ROUND(x, digits, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(NUMERIC '2.25' AS x, 1 AS digits), (NUMERIC '2.35', 1), (NUMERIC '2.251', 1), (NUMERIC '-2.5', 0)]) WITH OFFSET pos ORDER BY pos), ',')
=> "2.2,2.4,2.3,-2"

SELECT ROUND(x, digits, 'ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO') FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(NUMERIC '2.25' AS x, 1 AS digits)])
=> "2.3"

SELECT ROUND(x, digits) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS x, 2 AS digits)])
=> null

SELECT ROUND(x, digits, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS x, 2 AS digits)])
=> null

SELECT TRUNC(x, digits) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS x, 2 AS digits)])
=> null

SELECT ROUND(x, digits) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999' AS x, 1 AS digits)])
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.ROUND(x, digits) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999' AS x, 1 AS digits)])
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ROUND(x, digits, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(NUMERIC '-99999999999999999999999999999.999999999' AS x, -1 AS digits)])
=> null

SELECT TRUNC(x, digits) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999' AS x, -1 AS digits)])
=> "99999999999999999999999999990"

SELECT TRUNC(x, digits) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(NUMERIC '-99999999999999999999999999999.999999999' AS x, 1 AS digits)])
=> "-99999999999999999999999999999.9"

# N is INT64; no narrowing to DuckDB's INTEGER. NUMERIC's range and scale fix these results.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(ROUND(NUMERIC '1.25', digits) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([-9223372036854775808, 2147483648, 9223372036854775807]) AS digits WITH OFFSET pos ORDER BY pos), ',')
=> "0,1.25,1.25"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(ROUND(NUMERIC '-1.25', digits, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807]) AS digits WITH OFFSET pos ORDER BY pos), ',')
=> "0,-1.25"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(TRUNC(NUMERIC '-1.25', digits) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([-9223372036854775808, 2147483648, 9223372036854775807]) AS digits WITH OFFSET pos ORDER BY pos), ',')
=> "0,-1.25,-1.25"
